import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static long modularInverse(long a, long m) {
        assert m > 0;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        a %= m;
        if (a < 0) a += m;
        assert a != 0;
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return m - modularInverse(m, a) * m / a;
    }

    static class ModularNumber {
        int value;

        public static final int MOD = MOD;

        public ModularNumber() {
            this.value = 0;
        }

        public ModularNumber(long v) {
            this.value = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (this.value < 0) this.value += MOD;
        }

        public static ModularNumber operatorAdd(ModularNumber a, ModularNumber b) {
            ModularNumber res = new ModularNumber();
            res.value = a.value + b.value;
            if (res.value >= MOD) res.value -= MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static ModularNumber operatorSubtract(ModularNumber a, ModularNumber b) {
            ModularNumber res = new ModularNumber();
            res.value = a.value - b.value;
            if (res.value < 0) res.value += MOD;
            return res;
        }

        public static ModularNumber operatorMultiply(ModularNumber a, ModularNumber b) {
            return new ModularNumber(((long)a.value * b.value) % MOD);
        }

        public static ModularNumber operatorDivide(ModularNumber a, ModularNumber b) {
            return a.multiply(b.inverse());
        }

        public ModularNumber inverse() {
            return new ModularNumber(modularInverse(this.value, MOD));
        }

        public static boolean equals(ModularNumber a, ModularNumber b) {
            return a.value == b.value;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        final int n = 6;
        ModularNumber[][] p = new ModularNumber[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new ModularNumber(0);
            }
        }

        int _n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < _n; j++) {
                int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
                p[i][j] = new ModularNumber(a).divide(new ModularNumber(100));
            }
        }

        final int f = 20;
        ModularNumber[] sets0 = new ModularNumber[1 << f];
        ModularNumber[] sets1 = new ModularNumber[1 << f];
        Arrays.fill(sets0, new ModularNumber(0));
        Arrays.fill(sets1, new ModularNumber(0));

        List<Integer> masks0 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> masks1 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    int mask = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                    masks0.add(mask);
                    masks1.add(((1 << n) - 1) ^ mask);
                }
            }
        }

        assert masks0.size() == f;

        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            int totalMasks = masks0.size();
            int limit = 1 << (n / 2 * n);
            for (int e = 0; e < limit; e++) {
                ModularNumber prob = new ModularNumber(1);
                int[] edges = new int[n / 2];
                Arrays.fill(edges, 0);
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
                    boolean r = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    ModularNumber pp = p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n];
                    if (r) {
                        prob = ModularNumber.operatorMultiply(prob, pp);
                    } else {
                        ModularNumber oneMinusPP = new ModularNumber(1).subtract(pp);
                        prob = ModularNumber.operatorMultiply(prob, oneMinusPP);
                    }
                    edges[i / n] |= (r ? 1 : 0) << (i % n);
                }
                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < totalMasks; a++) {
                    int mask = masks0.get(a);
                    int[] rArr = new int[n / 2];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                        rArr[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    }
                    if (rArr[0] != 0 && rArr[1] != 0 && rArr[2] != 0) {
                        int totalBits = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[1] | rArr[2]);
                        if (totalBits == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(rArr[0] | rArr[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(rArr[1] | rArr[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets0[work_mask] = sets0[work_mask].add(prob);
            }
        }

        // Inclusion-exclusion
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                sets0[j ^ (1 << i)] = sets0[j ^ (1 << i)].add(sets0[j]);
            }
        }

        ModularNumber answer = new ModularNumber(0);
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
            ModularNumber term = sets0[j].multiply(sets1[((1 << f) - 1) ^ j]);
            answer = answer.add(term);
        }
        answer = new ModularNumber(1).subtract(answer);
        System.out.println(answer.value);
    }
}
